title: lavandula pedunculata var. atlantica
intro: Lavandula pedunculata var. atlantica, commonly known as Spanish Lavender or Lavender, is a shrubby evergreen plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its essential oil, which contains bioactive constituents such as linalool, linalyl acetate, and β-pinene, and is used in aromatherapy for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Spanish Lavender include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Spanish Lavender essential oil also include its ability to improve sleep quality and reduce stress levels, making it a popular choice for promoting overall well-being.
